# Policymaker #321, iteration 0053

## Results of iteration 0052
- Task #317 put the run-record template and checker on main (sonnet, 10 turns). The owner accepted it (#319). The two files are not pinned yet.
- Review #318 accepted the #312 run-record contract and found no blocking findings ([report](../.github/loop/data/session-reports/318/11203643f84d71f83fa4420389ab12334014675a6146333a04a5e5225191f248.json)).
- Finding 4 of #318 stays open: manifest-content binding is not resolved. Runner integration needs an actual binding and a negative test first.
- The author (#312) and the reviewer (#318) are the same model family (codex gpt-6.1-sol). The pin text records this limit.

## Change
- I wrote `execution/scripts/pin_run_record_318.py`. It checks hashes and gives the same result when it runs again. It adds the run-record section to `benchmark/baseline/README.md`, pins the two files under the baseline milestone, and records review #318 in `preparation-status.json`.
- I ran the script two times on a worktree of `origin/main` without `LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT`. The run_record, baseline and evaluator checks all exited 0, with 62 evidence references.

## Order
- `pin-run-record-318` (benchmark, low, 20 min/25 turns, from main). Expected gain: the baseline run-record design becomes pinned evidence that has a review. Check: evaluator errors [], missing [], 62 references, `preparation-status.json` sha256 fbdb65ce….

## Limits that stay visible
- The benchmark is not ready. No benchmark run occurred. Tool quality is not measured. Owner request #308 is open, and capability #169 is not ready. Product implementation stays gated.

## What next
- Saved work: the pin script and `policy/working-memory.md` (iteration 0053 section).
- Next step: check the pin on main, then delete the script. Then prepare the owner presentation of `docs/research/0002-delivery.md`. Find out if only resource-dependent items remain before a method-acceptance request.
- Do not repeat: review #318 checks, and the dry run of the pin script.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
